title: Encode thin-edge sync-only hop in CONTEXT.md and ADR
description:
## Why
AGENTS.md describes Client↔Gateway sync and microservice↔microservice async, but the gateway repo has no CONTEXT.md or ADR. Nothing versioned prevents sync fan-out / orchestration on the request path.

## What
Add CONTEXT.md (edge glossary) and an ADR: one hop per request, single owning microservice, no message bus in gateway src, no multi-owner sync orchestration. Optional review checklist for new routes.

## Context
Files: AGENTS.md, new CONTEXT.md, docs/adr/
Strength: Strong | mock (decision encoding)
Report: candidate C3
acceptance_criteria: CONTEXT.md and ADR exist under marketplace-mc or api-gateway; state 1-hop sync invariant and async-between-services; agents can discover without re-deriving from chat
close_reason: Closed in project DB; syncing contributor routing store

title: Deepen ProxyService interface (hide Axios)
description:
## Why
ProxyService interface leaks method/path/data/headers and AxiosResponse. Callers assemble raw HTTP; real depth (circuit breaker, x-user-* headers, error mapping, timeout) sits behind an interface nearly as wide as the implementation.

## What
Shrink interface to owner + intent → status+data (edge-typed failures). HttpService/Axios becomes an internal adapter at the seam. Auth login/register/session and health aggregate use the same interface.

## Context
Files: proxy.service.ts, proxy.module.ts, circuit-breaker.service.ts, auth.service.ts, app.controller.ts
Strength: Strong | ports & adapters
Report: candidate C2
acceptance_criteria: Callers no longer depend on AxiosResponse; outbound hop testable via seam mock/fake without Axios; circuit and header mapping remain inside Proxy module
close_reason: Closed in project DB; syncing contributor routing store

title: Unify domain forward into one proxy seam module
description:
## Why
Four identical private forward helpers (products/checkout/payments/users) fail the deletion test: deleting one removes local complexity but the same friction reappears in siblings. Shallow modules with large Nest route interface and pass-through implementation.

## What
Extract one OwnerForward (or equivalent) module at the gateway→owner seam: path/query preserve, body rules, status mirror, optional AuthUser. Controllers keep only routes + auth/roles decorators.

## Context
Files: products/checkout/payments/users controllers, build-service-path.ts, proxy.service.ts
Strength: Strong | in-process
Report: candidate C1
acceptance_criteria: Single forward implementation used by all domain controllers; no duplicated private forward; tests cover forward once at the seam

title: Downstream OpenAPI contract seam for gateway edge
description:
## Why
Swagger documents routes but bodies use additionalProperties: true. ValidationPipe does not validate proxy bodies. Client↔gateway and gateway↔owner seams are opaque without owner contracts.

## What
Consume or version OpenAPI (or stubs) per owning microservice; regenerate or reference edge DTOs without domain logic in the gateway.

## Context
Files: domain controllers, main.ts Swagger
Strength: Worth exploring | local-substitutable
Depends on owners publishing contracts (may be blocked externally)
Report: candidate C4
acceptance_criteria: Documented approach for owner contracts; at least one owner surface validated or stubbed at the edge; Swagger no longer only additionalProperties for that surface
close_reason: Closed in project DB; syncing contributor routing store

title: Deepen identity trust-header module (AuthUser → x-user-*)
description:
## Why
buildHeaders lives inside ProxyService; AuthUser is assembled in guards. Edge→owner trust policy (who injects x-user-*) is embedded in the HTTP forwarder — concern leakage across the transport seam.

## What
Dedicated module at the outbound seam: AuthUser (or absence) → canonical trust headers; Proxy only applies them. Session validation stays in the guard.

## Context
Files: proxy.service.ts, auth-user.ts, auth.guard.ts, jwt-strategy.ts
Strength: Worth exploring | in-process
Report: candidate C5
acceptance_criteria: Header mapping testable without HTTP; Proxy applies headers from one module; all owners receive the same trust header adapter
